# Settings reference

<!-- Generated by site/build.py from home/.chezmoidata/settings.toml. Do not edit by hand:
     run python3 site/build.py --docs -->

Every Setting UnMacOS understands, in the order of the Settings schema. 23 in all.
The setup wizard asks the install-phase ones, not the tune-phase ones.
Your answers live in `~/.config/unmacos/setup.toml`; any Setting you leave out keeps its default.

| Group | Key | Label | Type | Default | Range or choices | Help | Takes effect | Phase |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| git | `name` | Your name, for git commits | string | `""` | any text | Goes into ~/.gitconfig. Stays on this Mac. | apply | install |
| git | `email` | Your email, for git commits | string | `""` | any text | Goes into ~/.gitconfig. Stays on this Mac. | apply | install |
| look | `theme` | Theme | enum | `tokyo-night` | catppuccin, catppuccin-latte, ethereal, everforest, flexoki-light, gruvbox, hackerman, jade-horse, kanagawa, last-horizon, lumon, lupine, matte-black, miasma, nord, retro-82, ristretto, rose-pine, solitude, starship, tokyo-night, vantablack, white | The colours of the whole desktop. Switch any time with Alt + Ctrl + Shift + Space. | live | install |
| look | `corner_radius` | Corner radius | int | `8` | 0 to 24 | Roundness of windows, bar chips, popups and Spotify, in pixels. Apps pick it up when they restart. | apply | tune |
| bar | `weather` | Weather place | string | `auto` | any text | A city, airport code or zip for the bar's weather, or auto to use your IP address. | live | install |
| apps | `groups` | Extra apps to install | list | `(none)` | dev, apps, media, games, appstore | Optional Features, each a set of apps to install (brew/<name>.Brewfile). The desktop and terminal tools are always installed. | apply | install |
| apps | `skip` | Apps to leave out | list | `(none)` | any names | Apps in the chosen groups that should not be installed, by name. | apply | install |
| onepassword | `enabled` | Read secrets from 1Password | bool | `false` | on or off | For spotify_player's client ID. Needs the 1Password app and its CLI integration. | apply | install |
| onepassword | `spotify_client_id_ref` | Spotify client ID in 1Password | string | `op://Private/spotify-player/client_id` | any text | The 1Password reference spotify_player reads its client ID from. Only used when 1Password is on. | apply | tune |
| desktop | `animate` | Animate windows into place | bool | `true` | on or off | Windows glide to their new spot instead of jumping. | restart:rift | install |
| desktop | `focus_follows_mouse` | Focus follows the mouse | bool | `true` | on or off | The window under the pointer takes focus without a click. | restart:rift | install |
| desktop | `mouse_follows_focus` | Pointer follows keyboard focus | bool | `true` | on or off | Move the pointer to the window you focus with the keyboard. | restart:rift | install |
| desktop | `mouse_hides_on_focus` | Hide the pointer after a keyboard focus | bool | `true` | on or off | Hide the pointer after that until you move the mouse. | restart:rift | install |
| desktop | `dock_autohide` | Hide the Dock | bool | `true` | on or off | The Dock slides away until you move the pointer to the screen edge. | logout | tune |
| desktop | `dock_size` | Dock size | int | `64` | 16 to 128 | Size of the Dock's icons, in pixels (16 to 128). | logout | tune |
| keep | `ai` | Keep Apple Intelligence on | bool | `false` | on or off | UnMacOS turns Apple Intelligence off (macOS 26+). Set to true to leave it as it is. | apply | install |
| keep | `glass` | Keep Liquid Glass on | bool | `false` | on or off | UnMacOS turns Liquid Glass off (macOS 26+). Set to true to leave it as it is. | logout | install |
| keep | `wallpaper` | Keep my wallpaper | bool | `false` | on or off | UnMacOS sets the desktop wallpaper from the theme. Set to true to leave it as it is. | live | install |
| keep | `accent` | Keep macOS's accent colours | bool | `false` | on or off | UnMacOS sets macOS's accent and highlight colours from the theme. Set to true to leave them. | live | install |
| keep | `firefox` | Keep Firefox as it is | bool | `false` | on or off | UnMacOS themes Firefox with Pywalfox and Dark Reader. Set to true to leave it alone. | apply | install |
| keep | `firefox_wallpaper` | Keep Firefox's new tab page | bool | `false` | on or off | UnMacOS shows the theme's wallpaper on Firefox's new tab page. Set to true to leave it alone. | apply | install |
| keep | `spotify` | Keep Spotify as it is | bool | `false` | on or off | UnMacOS themes the Spotify app with Spicetify (media apps). Set to true to leave it alone. | apply | install |
| keep | `orca` | Keep Orca's colours | bool | `false` | on or off | UnMacOS recolours Orca to match the theme, if you use it. Set to true to leave it alone. | live | install |
